retrievalProfile.description: A centered photographic frame set within a solid blue field, featuring bold top-aligned sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a thick, solid blue border surrounding a thin white-outlined photographic frame. The photograph depicts a group of people posed around a vintage vehicle. Bold, white, tightly-spaced sans-serif text is centered in the upper margin.
coreVisualRelationships: Text centered in the top blue margin
Thin white stroke separating photo from blue background
Symmetrical balance between top text and bottom logo placement
coreInvariants: Thin white border around the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central photographic rectangle occupies approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold white title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top title down to the central photograph, then to the small logo at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial blue margins on all four sides create a 'window' effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for typography and framing lines
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Naturalistic earth tones within the photograph
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue field with high-contrast white text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for primary impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 1970s neo-grotesque aesthetic and weight.
Provides the necessary industrial, clean look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid cerulean blue square. In the center, place a rectangular photograph of a group of people with a vintage car, surrounded by a very thin white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, uppercase sans-serif text centered in the top blue margin. Add a small white circular logo centered in the bottom blue margin.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid blue?
Is the text white and uppercase?
Is there a thin white border around the photo?

mustAchieve: High contrast between blue and white

postGenerationChecks: Check for tight kerning in the title
Ensure the white frame is a single thin line
Verify the blue is a solid, flat color
Confirm the layout is perfectly square
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color field + Centered framed photo + Bold top-aligned sans-serif title.
